resources.string: Pick anything and show a QR code
Scan the code on the other phone
No accounts · No internet needed · Any file type
Open B+ Offline Share on the other phone and choose "Receive files"
Point the camera at the QR code shown on the sending phone
Direct link over this Wi-Fi · nothing goes online
Direct transfer between devices on this Wi-Fi, without an internet relay. Devices on different networks are not supported yet.
Shown to the other phone when pairing
Updates come from the B+ Offline Share GitHub releases page
The moment a new file appears in a folder you choose, it is sent automatically to a device or group you pick
Move chat & history to a new phone
When you pair a new device, your threads and transfer history can move with you
B+ Offline Share v%1$s · developed by Basem Helmy
May God have mercy and forgiveness on my father (Helmi Saadoun)
Pair a new device with a QR code. Tap a device to open its chat - messages and files travel together in one thread.
Files sent to the group reach every device in it.
B+ Offline Share is ready to receive
Other paired phones can reach this device
Camera permission is needed to scan the QR code
Allow notifications to know when files arrive
Device not reachable on this Wi-Fi. Pair again with a QR code.
Updates come from Bplus-Software/Bplus-Offline-Share. Android will ask before installation. Your chats and settings stay on this phone.
Allow B+ Offline Share to install updates on the next screen, then return here. You can turn this permission off afterward.
Keep this screen open. Interrupted downloads will resume on retry.
Verifying the app package, version and signing certificate.
Android installer opens after download and verification. Confirm there to finish.

Local transfers need a connection between phones. Mobile data alone is not enough.

1. Connect both phones to the same Wi-Fi.

2. Or turn on a hotspot on one phone and join it from the other.

3. Come back and check the connection.
No usable Wi-Fi or hotspot address found yet.
Internet access is not required. The network must allow phones to connect to each other.
The other phone is not responding
Keep B+ Offline Share open on both phones and check their network. On guest Wi-Fi, try another network or a hotspot. Details do not include pairing tokens or file contents.
Copy chat text and file records from %1$s? This is a one-time local copy. File contents are not copied. Existing threads on this phone are kept.
History copied. File records do not include the original files.
History was not copied. Check the other phone or existing threads.
Pair a device to start chatting.
Tap to open · hold for options
The original file is not available here or access has expired. Old chat records did not keep the file itself. You can locate a local copy.
No installed app can open this file type.
Use the file you selected as the local copy for %1$s? Check that you selected the right file.
Remove this message on this phone only? The original file stays saved. Nothing is deleted on the other device.
No reason was recorded by the older app. Retry to get current details.
Tap to retry or view connection details
Paired device record is missing. Pair again.
If a reply was lost, the other phone may already have received this message. Retrying may send it twice.
Device responded to the connection test

This tests the saved device address, not message delivery. Keep both apps open on a network that allows devices to communicate. Mobile-data internet transfer is not supported yet. A failed test alone does not prove the cause. No pairing tokens or message contents are copied.
Not sent · hold for details or retry
Visible only while this screen is open. Open Nearby on both phones on the same trusted Wi-Fi. Your name and photo are visible here. No files/chat are shared before acceptance.
No devices found yet. Keep Nearby open on both phones. Some routers block discovery. Use QR as a fallback.
Discovery could not start. Check Wi-Fi/permissions or use QR.
Waiting for the other device to accept
Names, photos and usernames are labels, not verified identities. Check with the other person before pairing.
Accept pairs the devices only. It does not copy chats or automatically send files.
Accepted. Keep this screen open until the other phone confirms.

Your generated username is a local label, not a globally reserved account. Photo and name are visible while Nearby is open and to accepted paired devices. No online directory. Tap the username to copy.
Saved. Pair again to refresh the profile on an existing device.
No chats here yet. Use + to pair nearby or scan a QR code.
This phone may not support the video format or access may have expired. The saved file is unchanged. Try another app.
New files use Downloads/B+ Share/Videos, Photos or Files. Old files stay where they are. Browse lets you choose an existing file; nothing is moved or deleted.
No available received files in this category yet.
Drag to position. Pinch to zoom. The circle previews your avatar. Original photo stays unchanged.
Local live group: the creator hosts it. The host and members must stay reachable on the same trusted Wi-Fi. No offline delivery, automatic history sync or internet chat.
Invitation from %1$s. Joining enables group text and file delivery on this Wi-Fi. No old history is copied.
Send a group invitation to %1$s? They must accept before group messages/files are delivered.
Invitation sent. Open Groups on the other phone.
No joined groups or invitations yet. Create a group or ask its host to invite your paired device.
This old chat record has no saved file reference. The file may still be in Downloads/B+ Share.
Access to this file is not allowed. Select it again to grant access. This does not prove it was deleted.
The saved file reference cannot be opened. It may have moved, become unavailable or been deleted.
The file provider is unavailable. Try selecting the original local file again.
Select the original copy and confirm it. Nothing will be moved or deleted. Same names do not prove it is the same file.
Remove %1$d chat cards on this phone only? Files stay on disk and other phones are unchanged.

Permanently delete up to %1$d selected local file copies? Original files you sent may also be selected. This cannot be undone; chat cards stay as records. Other phones are unchanged. Android may refuse protected files.
Delete request finished. %1$d files could not be deleted. Chat cards were kept.
Nothing was shared. Locate the unavailable file or deselect it, then try again.
Remove all file cards from this chat
Clear this conversation on this phone
Send all chat files to another device
Remove all file cards from this chat on this phone only? Text messages, actual disk files, the received library and other phones stay unchanged. This is not disk-file deletion.
Clear every message and file card in this conversation on this phone? Actual disk files, received library, pairing, group membership and other phones stay unchanged.
Send copies of %1$d chat file entries to %2$s? Originals and cards stay here. Repeated entries may send duplicate copies. No automatic retries.
No file cards in this chat
Remove 1 chat card on this phone only? Files stay on disk and other phones are unchanged.
Delete this message from this chat? The file stays on your phone.
Delete these %1$d messages from this chat? Files stay on your phone.
Send %1$d selected items as copies to %2$s? Originals stay here.
Delete this file from your phone? This cannot be undone. Other phones are unchanged.
Delete these %1$d files from your phone? This cannot be undone. Other phones are unchanged.
No saved file link. Find the file in your file manager.
Android or the file provider did not allow deletion. Delete it in your file manager.
This file is read-only to B+ Offline Share. Delete it in your file manager.
Delete for everyone is available in private chats only.
Select only messages or files you sent with this feature. Both phones need 1.1.10 or newer. Older items cannot be deleted remotely.
Delete the selected messages on both phones and their B+ Offline Share received files on the other phone? Your original files stay here. This cannot be undone.

Deleted on both phones: %1$d. Not confirmed: %2$d. Unconfirmed items stay in this chat. The other phone may be offline, outdated, or unable to delete the file. Try again or choose Delete from this chat.
Successfully deleted files were also removed from this chat. Failed items stay here.
Show newer pre-releases in the updater. Test versions may have bugs.
Hold to record, release to send, slide to cancel
Allow microphone access to record voice messages while this chat is open. Hold the mic to record, release to send, or slide sideways to cancel.
Recording. Release to send, slide sideways to cancel. Maximum 5 minutes.
Could not record. Check microphone access and try again.
Recording limit reached. This recording was discarded.
Release to send. Slide sideways to cancel.
When enabled, checks when the home screen opens, at most once every 6 hours while the app is running. No background checks, downloads or installs.
Share up to 20 files at once.
This app did not provide a readable content link.
Limit: 100 MB per file, 200 MB per share.
No supported text or files were shared.
Could not prepare this share. Nothing was sent.
Remove pairing and stop pending messages? Local chats and files stay. The other device is not erased. Pair again to reconnect.
Automatic file sending paused. Open the app and confirm each file before sending.
Review this capture, then confirm the destination before sending.
Camera permission denied. Nothing was sent.
Could not open the camera. Nothing was sent.
Capture is empty, unreadable or exceeds100MB. Nothing was sent.
Send NEW files automatically from this folder to your selected device/group? Existing files are skipped. No per-file confirmation for this opt-in. Direct children only, no subfolders.
Auto-send paused. Enable it again to baseline existing files and allow only new files.
Could not list the folder. Auto-send stays off, nothing was sent.
Continue to another app with these files? Choose the recipient and confirm there.
Off by default. When enabled, new files in the chosen folder are sent automatically to this device only.
Existing files are skipped. Local database prevents another automatic attempt for the same document, including after restart. Failed or uncertain sends need a manual retry. Direct folder files only.
Email and phone stay on this phone only. They are not shared with nearby or paired devices.
Could not save your profile. Please try again.
Only fields you enable are shown to accepted paired devices. Never sent in Nearby, unpaired discovery or groups.
Shared details unavailable. The peer may be offline or need version 1.0.4.
Waiting for a local Wi-Fi or hotspot network
Stop pairing, pending messages and automatic sends? Keep this device and its chat with a Not paired badge. Saved files and the other device stay unchanged.

Unpair and remove this device and its chat history from this phone? Pending messages and automatic sends stop. Saved files and the other device stay unchanged. Pairing again will not restore this local chat.
Could not save the device change. Please try again.
Completing pairing. Keep this screen open while the other device confirms.
Pairing completed. Returning to your chats…
Using the GitHub releases feed. Download integrity and signature checks still apply.
Saved check result, refreshed after 5 minutes.
GitHub is limiting update checks. Try again after %1$s. You can open the releases page instead.
GitHub is limiting update checks. Try later or open the releases page. Reset time is unavailable.
The backup feed has no verified newer update. Full API check is unavailable. Try again later.
Ready to send: %1$d files · %2$d text messages
Selecting a device does not send. Review the destination and files before sending.
Pairing was not confirmed by the other device. Keep both Nearby screens open and send a new request.
Receiver is not ready. Tap Refresh or copy details.
Found a service but could not resolve it. Tap Refresh or copy details.
No app could open this web link.
Waiting for the first file data
Search is continuous while this screen is open. Failed devices retry automatically. Manual Refresh is still available.
On by default. Up to 3 attempts, restarting from zero. Never retry a refusal or cancellation. Watched-folder sends are unchanged.
Cancelling. The receiver may already have saved the file.
Unpaired here; the other device will be told when it is reachable.
Could not save group. Try again.
Pair a device first, then invite it to this group.
